=== QUESTION 2: INTERPRETATION ===
PS3 gamma was approximately -0.094195; PS4 gamma is 1.3074786446659568.
The positive PS4 coefficient is more consistent with workers preferring higher expected wages.
Holding X and other wages fixed, a one-unit rise in Z_j changes log(P_j/P_8) by gamma.
A 1% rise in exp(Z_j) changes the odds by approximately 1.3074786446659568%.
The own-probability derivative is gamma*P_j*(1-P_j).
This comparison uses different data/sample coding; it does not by itself identify a causal effect.

=== Question 3c: Monte Carlo Integration ===

MC Density integral: 0.9974294606520748 (true: 1)
MC error is random and generally falls at rate 1/sqrt(D).
Increasing D from 1,000 to 1,000,000 reduces typical sampling error by sqrt(1000), about 31.6.
A particular draw need not improve every integral; truncation error also remains.
Quadrature uses deterministic nodes and unequal weights; uniform MC uses random nodes and equal (b-a)/D weights.
